route: Visitor's visa with section 11(2) authorisation to conduct work

permit.applies: The performer applies at a South African mission before travelling, for work for a foreign employer; the South African host company or organisation gives a stamped letter of invitation.
permit.first: A statement or documentation of the purpose, nature, place and duration of the work and proof of the remuneration the employer pays; it may be granted subject to a recommendation from a relevant organ of state.

fees.what: Visa fee where applicable, at the South African Embassy in Washington
Visa fee where applicable, at the South African High Commission in Canberra

permit.eligibility: in respect of films and advertisements produced in South Africa, including, but not limited to, an actor, cameraman, hairstylist, make-up artist or lighting and sound engineer; ... a person involved in the entertainment industry, travelling through the Republic to perform;

sources.title: Immigration Regulations 2014, regulation 11 (Visitor's visa), Acts Online, as amended to 9 October 2024
sources.said: in respect of films and advertisements produced in South Africa, including, but not limited to, an actor, cameraman, hairstylist, make-up artist or lighting and sound engineer; … a person involved in the entertainment industry, travelling through the Republic to perform; … proof of remuneration or stipend that the foreigner will receive from the employer; and … may, where applicable, be granted subject to a recommendation from any relevant organ of state; … shall not be extended beyond the validity period of the visa issued in terms of section 11(1)(a) of the Act.

sources.title: South African Embassy, Washington DC: Requirements for section 11(2) on visitor's visa, short term or urgent work (April 2025)
sources.said: for a period not exceeding three (3) months must hold authorization to conduct work in terms of section 11(2), which must be applied for and issued at a South African foreign embassy, before traveling to the Republic of South Africa. … $36.00 … PROCESSING TIME IS 5 BUSINESS DAYS AND MAY TAKE UP TO 10 DAYS DURING PEAK SEASON. … STAMPED LETTER OF INVITATION FROM THE SOUTH AFRICAN COMPANY/ ORGANIZATION CONFIRMING PURPOSE AND DURATION OF VISIT.

sources.title: South African High Commission, Canberra: Visitor's visa section 11(2), short work period authorisation
sources.said: Ten (10) working days should be allowed for processing from receipt of the application. … The visa is issued for a maximum period of 90 days with an expiry date 90 days from date of issue. … AUD 37.00

note: The fee is the mission's and varies by mission and nationality (charged 'where applicable'). Washington states five business days, up to ten in peak season; Canberra ten working days, so ten is taken. The authorisation can't be extended beyond the visitor's visa (reg. 11(7)(e)); the visa itself is for at most three months (90 days). Work in South Africa beyond that, or for a South African employer, needs a work visa, not modelled here.
